title: Ratio test
terms: ratio test; factorial series; absolute ratio; inconclusive ratio.

exposition.text:
For a series with eventually nonzero terms, set L = lim |a /a | when it exists. If L < 1,

the series converges absolutely; if L > 1 or L = ∞, its terms fail to tend to zero and the series
diverges. If L = 1, the test is inconclusive. This formulation applies to signed terms by using
absolute values.

solution.text:
The absolute ratio tends to |x|/4. The ratio test proves convergence when this is strictly
below 1 and is inconclusive at the two endpoints.
